title: Best Pull-Up Bar (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from the consumer‑review sites cited (CNET, TechGearLab, BarBend, and ShreddedDad) and ranked by how many sources mentioned them and the breadth of features highlighted.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a homeowner who wants a sturdy, removable doorway pull‑up bar that can also be used for floor ab workouts. The Iron Age Doorway Bar fits standard doorways, has padded grips, and comes already assembled, making it easy to install and store. Its main catch is that it is not a freestanding bar, so it requires a doorway.
